summary: Build practical TPRM skills with scorecards, monitoring dashboards, contract controls, and executive reporting. Enroll for 5-day advanced training.
lede: Third-party and vendor risk management helps you identify, assess, treat, monitor, and offboard external suppliers in a structured way. This course shows you how to classify vendors, evaluate inherent and residual risk, design onboarding workflows, and connect controls to vendor tiers. You will turn vendor information, contract requirements, and security assessments into practical tools such as risk registers, scorecards, assessment matrices, and governance packs. The course also addresses monitoring, escalation, reporting, and delivery challenges including incomplete data, legacy contracts, limited procurement capacity, and fragmented ownership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with suppliers, controls, contracts, or risk reporting and need a stronger operating model for third-party and vendor risk management.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: You should have working knowledge of procurement, supplier oversight, contract review, cybersecurity, or operational risk processes. Prior exposure to vendor questionnaires, SLA monitoring, or basic risk registers will help, but no coding is required. The course assumes you can interpret control evidence, read service contracts, and work with spreadsheet-based tracking or a GRC workflow tool. Advanced depth: Advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level, with selected topics introduced at conceptual level where implementation depends on your organization’s tooling and maturity.
